phase_name: Classify the --cached untracking shape before git add

objectives.description: Re-read the V2 classification loop in git-commit-scoped.sh
Insert new V11 case ahead of case 1, after V9/V10, routing matches into filtered_pathspecs + cached_untracking_pathspecs ledger, never add_pathspecs or dropped_pathspecs
Add contrasting block comments stating the new case's premise (content present) vs. case 2/V7 carve-out's premise (content gone)
Verify bash -n and run scratch probe (gitignored + non-gitignored repos)

notes: Scratch probe confirmed: git rm -r --cached sub with content on disk no longer exits 2 (genuinely_failed_adds refusal) in either gitignored or non-gitignored repo. git ls-files -- sub is empty after the script runs in both cases (non-gitignored silent revert is gone). Script exits 1 'nothing to commit' in both cases -- this is the documented, expected intermediate state closed by Phase 2's guarded bare-commit path, not a regression. Scoped suite run (run-all.sh --only <Tier Justification list>) surfaced 2 pre-existing failing suites (test-orchestrate-cycle-postflight.sh, test-redeploy-checkpoint-promotion.sh) unrelated to this edit -- verified identical failure counts against the unmodified HEAD copy of git-commit-scoped.sh; recorded in issue log, not fixed here (outside file_scope). test-git-commit-scoped.sh itself passed, confirming no regression to existing V2/V7/V9/V10 cases.
